notes.title: There is very little left before a major update and the release of the game
A small trailer presenting the features of the new version of the game
notes.notes:
Grab your revolver, spur your horse and prove to all the thugs that you are the best shooter in the entire Wild West! Exciting adventures, dynamic shootouts, chases, robberies and duels await you.

[previewyoutube=rJ7krYWOOHk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update from 01/18/2022
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added 2 levels
[*] Added a system for calculating player points, saving them and achieving them based on scoring
[*] Changed player collision mask
[*] Added Glitch effect
[*] Changes the point shader a bit
[*] Fixed a problem with camera shake at the beginning of level 8
[*] Minor tweaks and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Update from 01/17/2022
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added dynamic camera following the player
[*] Fixed horse physics
[*] Minor improvements on the levels
[*] Fixed a bug with the achievement "You Can't Run Away"
[/list]

notes.title: Changes as of 15.01.2022

[*] Test graphics replaced with final

notes.title: Release day update
notes.notes:
- The lighting, bitmap and sepia effects that were in the early screenshots have been introduced into the game.
- Fixed level with riding a horse.
- Fixed icons of dropped weapons.
- All environments in the same style - without bright colors and effects.
